purpose: Teach: 佞/膺/从/レイプ/横田/中原/田口/五郎

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の佞言、つまり佞の偽証を、警察、慎重に分析されますね
lines.en: The police are analyzing the suspect's false testimony very carefully in this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured cadence. Slightly formal register—academic but not stiff. Gentle upward lilt at the end, inviting confirmation. Even-paced, no rush.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の膺、つまり胸部の損傷を鑑識されますね
lines.en: The police are conducting forensic examination of the victim's chest injuries, aren't they?
lines.style: Calm, procedural tone. Professional but not cold. Steady delivery matching Ren's pace. Affirmative energy—confirming what's being done. Slight weight on the main clause.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、古文書の从、つまり旧字「從」の解読を、警察、専門家に依頼されますね
lines.en: The police are requesting expert help to decipher the classical document characters in this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Contemplative, patient. Slight pause before the specific detail. Clear enunciation on technical terms. Measured pace suggesting careful consideration. Soft upswing at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、レイプ被害者保護を、警察、最優先に対応されますね
lines.en: The police are making victim protection their top priority in this rape case, aren't they?
lines.style: Direct, steady. Firm conviction underneath—no hesitation on the priority. Respectful tone, not clinical. Clear emphasis on 'top priority.' Grounded, supportive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、横田基地周辺の事案を、警察、米軍と連携されますね
lines.en: The police are coordinating with the U.S. military regarding this incident near Yokota Air Base, aren't they?
lines.style: Methodical, formal. Slightly elevated register reflecting the jurisdiction complexity. Deliberate pacing. Light stress on 'coordinating.' Acknowledges the scope of the case.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者中原の前科を、警察、慎重に確認されますね
lines.en: The police are carefully confirming the suspect Nakahara's prior convictions, aren't they?
lines.style: Even, authoritative. Bureaucratic precision without coldness. Steady tempo. Slight weight on 'carefully'—showing due diligence. Professional certainty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、参考人田口氏から、警察、事情を丁寧に聴かれますね
lines.en: The police are taking careful statements from witness Mr. Taguchi in this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Inquisitive but respectful. Slightly slower pace—showing care in the process. Gentle on the witness name. Upward inflection inviting agreement. Attentive listening energy.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者五郎氏のご家族への配慮も、警察、されますね
lines.en: The police are also showing consideration toward the victim Mr. Goro's family, aren't they?
lines.style: Warm but measured. Compassionate undertone without sentimentality. Slight softness when naming the victim. Even pacing. The 'also' carries weight—showing comprehensive care.
